value.text: The vet found a squeaky toy, an undigested shoe, and an eighty-six carat diamond lodged in the dog's stomach.

ops.old: Bacon, sausages, fried eggs, baked beans, black pudding, mushrooms and grilled tomato with buttered toast.
ops.new: Grill 8 rashers bacon and 8 pork sausages, fry 4 eggs, 4 slices black pudding and 200g mushrooms, warm 1 tin baked beans, grill 2 halved tomatoes and serve with 8 slices buttered toast.
